name: San Fernando (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of San Fernando (a lion and the Virgin above waves, within a wreath, inscribed).
history: The flag of the island municipality was completely white from its adoption in 1989 until 2010; after the commemoration of the bicentenary of the Cortes de Cádiz this colour was replaced by blue, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: San Fernando arms — lion and the Virgin above waves within a wreath
